displayFirstOpening.tool: the display probe, each opening the first of a fresh browser and profile, after the install records

displayRealSurfaces.tool: Playwright; the real popup opened by chrome.action.openPopup(), its action not pinned (popup) and pinned on the toolbar (popupPinned), and the real side panel by chrome.sidePanel.open() on a click; an extension page reaches each with chrome.extension.getViews and runs the display probe in it; times from the open request, on the extension process clock

journey.tool: Playwright on the built extension, the reading model: rendered words at 238 wpm, the typing demo watched to its end, KLM 1.3 s per action, machine time by the test clock
